info.name: OpenRegister API: translation, names, dashboard, linked entities, MDM and integrations
info.description: Newman API coverage (SIG round t1, lane T25) for TranslationController (setStatus, bulkTranslate), NamesController, DashboardController, LinkedEntityController, AggregationController, QualityController, MergeController (reverse), SurvivorshipController, ContactsController, ContactSearchController, EmailsController, EmailLinksController, PartyController, CalendarEventsController, DeckLinksController, DeckController and TalkLinksController. Each route gets a success path, a missing/unknown id, invalid input where the method validates, and the access answer for a non-admin user without rights next to the admin, with a control read that the refusal changed nothing. Routes that need Mail, Deck or Talk (absent in CI) assert the documented app-not-available answer. The collection seeds its own data: `00 setup` creates a non-admin user, a register, an admin-only schema and two objects; `99 teardown` deletes them. Variables: base_url, admin_user, admin_password.

exec: // OCS-APIRequest lets the CSRF-guarded app routes accept basic-auth calls, as the SPA's token would.
